name: Shadow Discharge AP
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: The shadow beacon's operation causes harmful energy to blast out of the base of the device.
disable:
DC 27 Crafting or DC 27 Thievery (master) to rig a dispersal system, or DC 27 Arcana , DC 27 Nature , DC 27 Occultism , or DC 27 Religion (master) to safely vent the magical energy; four total successes in any combination to disable

Special Disabling the shadow discharge does not disable the shadow beacon.
routine:
(1 action) The shadow beacon fires shadows into the sky, discharging excess energy out of the device's lower half. The trap deals 4d6 Cold Damage|options:area-damage] damage to all non-shadow creatures in a 60ft Type:emanation from the base of the device (Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save). For each successful check to disable the trap, the cold and void damage dealt by the trap on subsequent rounds are both reduced by 1d6 damage (see below). A creature that fails their save is pushed back 10 feet (15 feet on a critical failure).

3d6 Cold Damage|options:area-damage]

2d6 Cold Damage|options:area-damage]
